reporting_lag: The most recent month is withheld until it is complete, so as_of normally trails the current month by one to two months. A file refreshed today can legitimately carry an older as_of.
coverage_note: History is published from 2000-01, the inception date on the PivotalPath factsheets. iQNT begins later; per-index coverage is in index_statistics.csv (coverage_start, months).

files.index_catalog_extended.csv: sub-indices, names and descriptions only (no returns)
files.index_return.csv: monthly returns, net of fees, decimal
files.index_statistics.csv: per-index statistics derived from index_return.csv - since inception, trailing periods and named quarters
files.cy_returns.csv: calendar-year returns, one row per index-year
